result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one section heading displays a raw localization key instead of translated text.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the translation key so the heading displays the intended localized text (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing keys never render raw.
